programme.title: 兒女是我們的
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……

programme.title: 十四女英豪
programme.desc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將,世世代代為國而戰,子子孫孫為民而死,直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全營將士壯烈犧牲楊宗保身負箭傷,被困金山,以身殉國楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇,在老祖母佘老太君的發起下,組成了一支楊家軍,誓與番邦周旋到底!

programme.title: 教頭
programme.desc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害,成殺人疑犯,惟匿藏孟家任教頭後王收好武青年周平為徒,卻惹孟不滿;原來周、孟兩大族為死敵,孟覺聘王當教頭,實乃養虎為患,遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲,幸王逃過大難,只是受了傷孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為,且對王很有好感,遂暗中援手

programme.title: 至尊一劍
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超,連敗九十九名劍手,終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍,遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹,奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分,矢誓報仇,不自量力挑戰五新,結果被打落懸崖之下

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋,其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿,意圖賣瘋傳毒貞蓮將真相和盤托出,孝文感於貞蓮真情,決意回鄉稟明母親,迎接貞蓮返家孝文走後,貞蓮萬念俱灰,竟狂飲毒酒,以圖自盡

programme.title: 成記茶樓
programme.desc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港,在屋邨經營茶樓,本想安分守己,卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁,而警方卻袖手旁觀,迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙!

programme.title: 插翅虎
programme.desc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭,插翅虎及活閻王,的武功,他們必定獨霸武林,江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟,決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞?誰可挽救一場武林浩劫?

programme.title: 少林五祖
programme.desc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為少林五祖

programme.title: 舞衣
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉

programme.title: 十二金牌
programme.desc: 奸相秦檜偽造十二道金牌,密謀強召抗金前線的岳飛退兵華山俠士苗龍為救國運,率江湖義士沿途設卡攔截金牌不料護送金牌的爪牙首領竟是其恩師金彥堂,令苗龍陷入忠義兩難最終師徒在客棧反目血戰,苗龍雖拚死奪下金牌,卻仍難挽回歷史的千古遺憾

programme.title: 蛇王子

programme.title: The Fight Machine
programme.desc: Paul與Robby,一個為了找回生活的掌控權而自願沉淪,一個為了擺脫家庭的財務泥潭而鋌而走險。兩人在毫無規則、拳拳見血的地下非法格鬥場中一路廝殺。最終,在一場血肉橫飛的終極對決裡,兩個傷痕累累的靈魂

programme.title: 熱血燃燒
programme.desc: 緝毒精英陳泰樺、老米、阿峰與阿棠奉命秘密緝捕跨國毒梟,卻因隊內黑警洩密,行動甫展開便落入圈套。阿峰當場殉職,隊長盧Sir壯烈犧牲,阿棠則神秘失蹤,兄弟情誼自此崩離。多年後,倖存的陳泰樺與老米誓要查明真

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相

programme.title: 倒數回擊
programme.desc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒

programme.desc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能

programme.title: 奇異地球 #2 英普

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.desc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船

programme.title: 動物知心友 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人

programme.title: 動物知心友 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #1
programme.desc: 非洲的三大貓科動物:獅子,花豹和獵豹雖然並肩而居,但他們各自發展出專門的狩獵策略,以避免彼此衝突深入了解這些頂級獵食者的生活和故事

programme.title: 歐洲野性王國 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長

programme.title: 歐洲野性王國 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全

programme.title: 生命之旅 #2 英普
programme.desc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #1
programme.desc: 探索美麗的海德堡城堡,它的廢墟屹立在德國西部的內卡河旁這座城堡位於受保護的自然保育區中,是猛禽的家園,亦是附近兩棲類的產卵場

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #2
programme.desc: 前往擁有數百年歷史的法國堡壘,它是史上一些最偉大帝國的家園卡爾卡松曾是財富和文化的中心,如今已成為野生動物的避難所鳥類,野豬和昆蟲大軍在其豐裕的環境中生存

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #3
programme.desc: 發掘刻在洞穴裡世上最大的城堡斯洛文尼亞的洞窟城堡不僅為中世紀的人類居民提供了保護,而且還為該區的鳥類,野豬和野山羊提供了避難所

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #4
programme.desc: 遊覽西班牙格林納達地區一生必到的非凡堡壘- 阿爾罕布拉宮這個世界文化遺產現在成了該地區野生動植物的庇護所它擁有眾多溪流和噴泉,可供應兩棲類,魚類和鳥類

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #5
programme.desc: 瞭解世上最壯觀的建築之一 - 新天鵝堡及其周邊的森林如何成為許多生物的家園從阿爾卑斯羱羊到雄偉的天鵝,這座城堡於數世紀以來成了天然避難所

programme.title: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 英普
programme.desc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #2
programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種

programme.title: 拉丁美生態奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大

programme.title: 拉丁美生態奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 英普
programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 英普
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒

programme.title: 奇異地球 #1 英普
programme.desc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能

programme.title: 奇異地球 #2 英普
programme.desc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 生命之旅 #2 英普
programme.desc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #1
programme.desc: 探索美麗的海德堡城堡,它的廢墟屹立在德國西部的內卡河旁這座城堡位於受保護的自然保育區中,是猛禽的家園,亦是附近兩棲類的產卵場

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #2
programme.desc: 前往擁有數百年歷史的法國堡壘,它是史上一些最偉大帝國的家園卡爾卡松曾是財富和文化的中心,如今已成為野生動物的避難所鳥類,野豬和昆蟲大軍在其豐裕的環境中生存

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #3
programme.desc: 發掘刻在洞穴裡世上最大的城堡斯洛文尼亞的洞窟城堡不僅為中世紀的人類居民提供了保護,而且還為該區的鳥類,野豬和野山羊提供了避難所

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #4
programme.desc: 遊覽西班牙格林納達地區一生必到的非凡堡壘- 阿爾罕布拉宮這個世界文化遺產現在成了該地區野生動植物的庇護所它擁有眾多溪流和噴泉,可供應兩棲類,魚類和鳥類

programme.title: 壯麗的「堡」貝 #5
programme.desc: 瞭解世上最壯觀的建築之一 - 新天鵝堡及其周邊的森林如何成為許多生物的家園從阿爾卑斯羱羊到雄偉的天鵝,這座城堡於數世紀以來成了天然避難所

programme.title: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 英普
programme.desc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #1
programme.desc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #2
programme.desc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊

programme.title: 鯊魚星球 #3
programme.desc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種

programme.title: 拉丁美生態奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大

programme.title: 拉丁美生態奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 英普
programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況

programme.title: 大貓九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神

programme.title: 大貓九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 英普
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇

programme.title: 芭比的故事
programme.desc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒

programme.title: 萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生
programme.desc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到荷里活的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展、個人生活、心理健康、慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力

programme.title: 休傑克曼:演藝巨星
programme.desc: 從百老匯舞台到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華、最全能的表演者之一這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉「金鋼狼」一角名揚全球的星路歷程透過舞台上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員、歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌

programme.title: 芭比的故事
programme.desc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒

programme.title: 野性厄瓜多 #1
programme.desc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅

programme.title: 野性厄瓜多 #2
programme.desc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #3
programme.desc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #4
programme.desc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #5
programme.desc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #4
programme.desc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #5
programme.desc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源全國有近 30,000台風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #1
programme.desc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #4
programme.desc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩托車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食、果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #5
programme.desc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐、與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球、打棒球、享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #6
programme.desc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德里格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊、體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca)他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園、品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas)

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #7
programme.desc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #8
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 2 #1
programme.desc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水

programme.title: 重塑:瑪麗蓮·夢露 #3
programme.desc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司

programme.title: 重塑:瑪麗蓮·夢露 #4
programme.desc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞

programme.title: 基努李維:獨一無二
programme.desc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #1
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #2
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器

programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches

programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out However, Pu Yi was not alone Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today

programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own The crime shocked the whole country What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief

programme.title: 虛空魔境 #13

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
programme.desc: 呂沛淵牧師是美國西敏神學院神學博士。曾任洛杉磯台福神學院系統神學及教會歷史專任教授。現任美國加州矽穀一華人教會牧師與神學院教授。邁向新一年, 呂牧師以《創世記》, 探討上帝創造世界與你今天的關係, 為一年之始作好準備。

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.desc: 對肥媽而言，十人大餐零難度，先煮其中四道菜及一個湯。加入紅菜頭烹煮的羅宋湯，有甚麼特別益處？肥媽示範用椰菜花剁碎，務求做出西瓜pizza以外的另一經典！六號請纓用手拍青瓜，配合簡易的汁料，演繹製作「手拍黃瓜」的容易度。肥媽動手把花龍蝦開邊，讓牠變身為美味的「芝士香草龍蝦」宴客菜。一塊優質安格斯肉眼扒，為何肥媽不塗橄欖油而用芥花籽油？煎扒時與觀眾溫故知新，重提冷藏牛扒處理重點。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 胸腺屬於免疫系統器官，主要功能是協助抵抗感染、疾病。胸腺一旦出現腫瘤，有機會影響呼吸，甚至誘發重症肌無力，留意心胸肺外科醫生帶來診治資訊。沈宗賢、阮慧珊帶同新合唱歌<伽利略的星星作客節目，暢談這首浪漫情歌的創作故事。阮阮笑言因彼此太熟，初時難以投入演繹戀人氛圍。談到錄音趣事，阮阮「控訴」頻頻被拍檔宗賢糾正普通話發音，二人還會即席獻唱新歌。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨示範香濃美食「咖喱牛肉手抓餡餅」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: 打工仔關心勞工法律問題，笑稱是「無良僱主」的林盛斌也來一解疑惑。親戚來港旅遊卻在家人的餐廳義務工作，老闆可有犯法？至於僱員在家工作時被燙傷，Bob直言僱主不用負法律責任，韵芝以澳洲個案反駁其觀點。老闆向遲到員工扣薪，撥入「下午茶福利」，認為合法的Bob再次未獲女神們支持，結果如何？若介紹客戶到夜總會進行性交易但沒收取報酬，可屬違法？祖儀笑言「金牌媒人」Bob的撮合行為與個案性質相近，惹眾人爆笑！

programme.title: 大帥哥#1粵PG
programme.desc: 大元帥狄奇來到昇威鎮，鎮民與鄰近三個地方大帥李細龜、麥先根、佘南一同恭候。大帥府內，狄奇與兄弟馬炭、羅義、冬來吃着鮑參翅肚，憶起戰場上分吃蟑螂的經歷。革命黨員章沅婉以笛聲引來狄奇，伺機刺殺他惜事敗，狄奇竟輕易放了她及其同黨。翌晨，真的大元帥蒙大同來到，怒責狄奇放了革命黨，四兄弟被囚。冬來成功帶眾人逃獄，惜馬炭中槍。狄奇明白自己只是大同的替身，決定返大帥府取回應得的；另一邊廂，沅婉喬裝進入大同壽宴。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 媽媽叫小丸子提早寫賀年咭，小丸子心生一計，便是親手送出賀年咭，然後私吞郵費。老人會年尾表演話劇，爺爺本來飾演配角森石松，卻因主角演員受傷而變成飾演次郎長，小丸子為他進行特訓。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，兒童體適能教練將會指導主持姐姐與三位小朋友，挑戰一連串平衡力，以及協調能力的訓練。這些鍛練不但有助刺激肌肉和骨骼發育，而且對提升日常運動表現大有幫助。首先利用豆袋、雪糕筒等輔助道具強化平衡力，還有以單腳站立的動作，大家要穩定控制身體重心。稍作休息過後，教練又指導眾人在敏捷梯上練習雙腳進出、逐格開合跳、側向爬行等動作，大家表現如何？

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 公主與史納樂隊奮力消滅邪音魔軍團，可是凱蘿卻讓邪音魔以更快速度增生。經過一番苦惱，奈津想到她能夠做的事，就是透過直播，向世人呼籲做自己喜歡的事。這種快樂與熱愛，正是音樂之力的泉源。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 粵劇是廣東傳統戲曲，有人為了做大戲，放棄了自己的正職，甚至還投資了不少金錢。將自己的青春奉獻給粵劇，希望有朝一日，可以成為名伶。新聞掏寶和大家重溫2005年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
宏利保險呈獻：灣區零距離粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 汽車在高速公路撞到水馬，被相關隧道公司索償近八萬。車主質疑對方指稱撞毀「風琴式防撞緩衝裝置」的說法，認為賠償金額不合理。老婦被瘋狂推銷達八百樽補充品，花逾十萬元購入包含纖體丸的五款產品，涉事店員更稱日服四百粒才見效？事主女兒大控訴，指店方等同謀財害命！攝製隊到店秘密調查，也向醫生詢問服用大量補充品的嚴重後果。《美食強人》眾主持約同名廚評審，往GBA評級食店聚餐兼慶功。另帶來有助促進關節健康的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#68粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰為家中開銷激增而煩惱，嘉驄為賺錢替她分憂，答應將網漫《圓嬤嬤正傳》IP售予陳公子，並承諾圓圓不再醜化她。嘉驄將圓嬤嬤升格為圓妃，構思她與奸妃角力的全新宮鬥故事，惟陳公子要求加入色情元素。嘉驄礙於合約在身，只好瞞著圓圓繪畫圓妃與太監的奸情……嘉驄對圓圓漸生特別感覺，刻意惹怒對方以免繼續胡思亂想，怎料觸動她遭冠一冷待的傷心事。嘉驄為開解圓圓而滿足她的要求，惹來朱基誤會，冠一又在此時來找圓圓……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#4粵PG
programme.desc: 德龍從無雙處取回子盈之物，並回想與子盈的甜蜜往昔。菲雅在過去已情傾德龍，當年得知德龍與子盈在一起時，竟藉拍戲公報私仇。未幾，子盈便陷入醜聞風波。子盈即使醜聞纏身，仍獲雲生包容，惹來鳳儀妒忌……雲生打算全力推動串流平台計劃，鳳儀傾力協助，向無雙明言無暇抽身拍攝《玫瑰》，並指綺雲、菲雅亦已推辭，無雙心下一沉……雲生欲拉攏何氏基金合作，卻遭主席何永康奚落，無雙深信此事必能促使雲生加速開拍《玫瑰》。

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 蝦餃展現點心師傅的極致手藝，「皮餡摺蒸」步驟統統甚為講究，平民小店、星級食府都有創意用心之作。銅鑼灣的新派點心店以中西合璧做法，奉上破格的黑金蝦餃，評審們卻認為墨魚汁皮反而令經典美食不再晶瑩通透，黑松露亦遮蓋了蝦的鮮味，有所扣分？澳門某酒店中菜館以金魚為主題，將蝦餃升呢藝術品。栩栩如生的「金魚餃」，用上清甜爽脆的刺身級藍天使蝦，味道與賣相兼備！有名廚見證金魚餃的「進化」，並形容是千錘百鍊的成果。

programme.title: 武則天#24粵普
programme.desc: 太子妃發現稱心未死，徐慧設計讓世民撞破真相。世民親赴邙山殺死稱心；李泰與韋妃則計劃把蕭薔難產嫁禍媚娘。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
騙中傳奇#9粵
programme.desc: 余實為彌補忠正輕薄玉麟一事，決定讓忠正入贅守言家，並使忠正及玉麟米巳成炊，兩人卻不肯就範。二老假裝病入膏肓，才令二人勉強應允。成婚當天，忠正受盡淩辱才可進門，巳感氣結，於是命顧井將所有禮金收起，用作私房錢，但顧井卻被寶兒將禮金全數騙去，忠正雖惱顧井，但兄弟一場，遂原諒了顧井。忠正與玉麟自成婚後，經常勢不兩立，卻又要在兩老面前扮恩愛，雙方均感疲累。布政大人找忠正鑑證罕有的女兒紅，玉麟得悉後大表驚慌。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#225粵
programme.desc: 慶發起在社區中心千叟宴，惜因食物供應商被查封，不能提供食物，慶將事情揹於身上，高家會總動員幫忙。可是慶回到家中，欲提出此事時，眾人卻因要準備過年物件，根本沒有人理會慶。結果，只有麗及亨答應幫忙。

programme.title: 玉樓春#39粵普
programme.desc: 孫金閣搗騰一些玩意竟發生爆炸，玉樓和哥哥詳談之下發現金閣是有遠大抱負的人；少春趁機把金閣推薦給皇上；孫遜發現少春懷有東鮫珠，一問之下才知是柳三絕給她的，勾起了孫遜的一段青春回憶。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵PG
programme.desc: 「星夢」歌手同門較量，周柏豪夥拍連詩雅，對戰謝東閔與戴祖儀。日本拉麵文化博大精深，主打魚介湯底的拉麵店內多個虹吸式咖啡壺，有甚麼作用？雜貨店內每件商品僅得一件，卻非二手貨物，兩隊須猜出店舖貨源。泰式按摩花款多多，一款條狀物件有何另類用途？冰島一場所因擺放「神聖之物」，吸引不少充滿好奇心的旅客；兩隊競猜箇中「最大」與「最小」，Do姐見眾人一臉蠢相，大方給予貼士！哪一隊能獲幸運之神眷顧，贏得高額獎金？

高朋滿座#226粵
programme.desc: 大年初一，三妗婆帶著小豬拜年，原來三趁著豬年特意由長洲帶名為「阿金」的小豬，圖將福氣帶來高家，情看到阿金後便愛不釋手。當晚高家即召開會議，商討如何處理阿金。眾人你推我讓，最後一致通過由情親自照顧阿金。

programme.title: 玉樓春#40粵普PG
programme.desc: 賈逢源跟梁京冠謀劃扳倒孫遜，決定先除掉孫貴妃。他利用潘才人喪子之事大做文章，找來李太醫指證是孫貴妃令大皇子感染瘟疫而死。林少春為孫貴妃打抱不平，提出疑點，皇上批准召李太醫家人進宮，同時下旨包圍孫府。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 為延續未完的十人餐，肥媽抵買當造海鮮、健康的三色藜麥及矜貴鴨肝，分別煮出「雜錦海鮮大鑊飯」及「煎法國鴨肝伴焦糖蘋果」，惹眾人垂涎。但她還要處理三包鴨血，用攪拌了的鴨血漿燜煮一塊塊的鴨血，煮出一道「鴨血煮鴨血」，還有用西芹、洋蔥、甘筍，以西式的方法燜煮豬腩肉，過程中竟教大家英語生字。肥媽妙用椰皇的特性切開少許椰殼，將蛋白、奶、糖、燕窩放進去，清甜的飯後甜品「椰皇鮮奶燕窩」吸引眾人等着起筷！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 耳咽管主要負責調節耳壓、引流分泌物，一旦出現問題，便可能演變成耳咽管開放症或阻塞症，惟兩者的病徵、成因與治療方法均截然不同。耳鼻喉科醫生詳釋相關資訊，也會帶來有助舒緩不適的方法。黃劍文、譚偉權作客節目，暢談結伴舉辦音樂會的緣由。音樂會引領觀眾回顧香港音樂劇發展，更破格融入粵曲元素，構思何來？兩人分享與新生代演員合作感受，劍文還預告會挑戰唱粵曲。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範「海鮮紅燒豆腐」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: KOL為吸Like，在社交平台舉辦抽獎活動。嘉賓吳業坤本認為犯法，卻想起自己也曾派福利送贈簽名相，慌忙要轉軚！一時錯手將淫褻影片發放到通訊軟件群組，可會觸犯法例？坤哥「衰多口」，令祖儀火起要「動武」。錄取偶像演出片段進行二次創作，並於網上發佈。眾人只着眼於侵犯版權事宜，到律師解答時方知是涉及私隱條例。坤哥諗到頭痛，更笑言想中途離場……部份店舖會將疑似小偷的截圖張貼出來，以警惕公眾，此舉卻可能違法？

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子、小玉和藤木去到小翠祖父朋友的農場摘檸檬，用新鮮檸檬炮製的檸檬水甜美可口。小丸子為添置新裝，提議拍攝全家福，最終成事，惟拍攝途中下雨，以為要中止之際，小丸子提議在家中拍攝。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 開啟AI程式，掌握輸入指令的技巧，就可跟着步驟利用家中材料自製STEM玩具。本集「AI小學堂」主題是「DIY紙板扭蛋機製作教學」，老師帶出用指令向AI提問的七大重點。完成扭蛋機後，還可要求AI模擬添加裝飾的示意圖呢！忙碌生活中，有時亦要學懂減壓，這次「開心SHARE」收集能令小朋友放鬆的事。某投稿者熱愛踢足球，亦有人喜好文靜活動，繪畫、欣賞藝術都可將煩惱暫時放下，主持傾談間更發覺大家同樣偏好文字。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵與美月雙雙升上初中二年級，剛當上星光偶像公主的二人，搖身一變成為全校焦點，阿紡也以娃娃姿態跟二人一起上學。聽說最近有個模特兒人氣急升，陽葵與美月於是進入偶像公主空間一探究竟。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
programme.desc: 天后一個1,000平方呎單位，以畫廊作靈感，同時利用對比色，營造現代風格，整體效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#69粵
programme.desc: 富家子Haydrian欲入股程祥劍的健身室遭拒，竟另起爐灶，挖走除安多勳外的所有教練，又游說業主加租，祥劍更因被傳破產而遭債主追債。多勳外出派傳單招攬學員時，結識患有痛症的老伯，遂免費指導他鍛鍊身體，卻因此遭健身室職員宋美芢責難及驅趕，惟他仍對老伯關懷備至。祥劍安排多勳參加電視台體能比賽，冀提升知名度以招攬學員，多勳積極備戰，全力以赴，惟終究無力扭轉困局，健身室被迫停業之際，突然迎來轉機……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#5粵PG
programme.desc: 《玫瑰》試戲場上，無雙、綺雲演技火花四濺，雲生拍板由綺雲擔任女主角……菲雅遭永康訓斥沒好好維繫與家俊的夫妻關係，菲雅敢怒不敢言。無雙使計刺激菲雅的演戲欲，令她考慮接拍《玫瑰》。寶兒向德龍透露自己獲邀請加入天誠，心情忐忑，德龍向她訴說「朋友」的經歷。德龍本獲安排參演《玫瑰》，卻被雲生抽起。家俊因為菲雅故意在素希面前宣示主權，與菲雅大吵一場。酒醉的菲雅往找德龍；另邊廂，素希偷拍與家俊的親密照。

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 延續「點心之王」蝦餃戰火，要在經典滋味注入新意，如何做到恰到好處？廣州老牌酒店以紅菜頭汁、菠菜汁變奏雙色蝦餃，加上鮮藤椒作點綴，神秘美食團卻就味道是否融和引發不同聲音。外皮易穿似成另一焦點，某名廚更直言該餐廳的原版蝦餃比較美味？回到香港中環地標古蹟覓食，傳統蝦餃外表滲透着點點驚喜，黑松露、芫荽的嶄新組合，加上沙葛、松露油等味道層次，提鮮不搶鮮！嘉賓滕麗名私心推介放題、暢飲時段，享受非一般用餐體驗。

programme.title: 武則天#25粵普
programme.desc: 承乾因稱心之死心灰意冷，暗中籌備謀反。媚娘夜訪東宮勸阻，承乾坦承逼宮決心，令她陷入告發與報恩的兩難。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
騙中傳奇#10粵
programme.desc: 正忠正闢室作試酒場地，因不懂女兒紅特性，糟蹋了整酲美酒。九斤二與玉麟趕至時，忠正巳醉昏，玉麟為替忠正補鑊，到友人杜承康之酒莊一行，事件才完滿解決。布政使作出重賞，但忠正卻以為憑己本事爭取回來。忠正為免忠正再出洋相，使計令他前往杭州驗貨。杭州怡紅院內，寶兒突出現，眾富商要忠正所驗證的，卻是寶兒是否處子之身，忠正雖感為難，但仍能過關，但顧井對寶兒淪落風塵，頓感心痛。顧井為救寶兒，不惜將眾富商打昏。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#226粵
programme.desc: 大年初一，三妗婆帶著小豬拜年，原來三趁著豬年特意由長洲帶名為「阿金」的小豬，圖將福氣帶來高家，情看到阿金後便愛不釋手。當晚高家即召開會議，商討如何處理阿金。眾人你推我讓，最後一致通過由情親自照顧阿金。

programme.title: 玉樓春#40粵普PG
programme.desc: 賈逢源跟梁京冠謀劃扳倒孫遜，決定先除掉孫貴妃。他利用潘才人喪子之事大做文章，找來李太醫指證是孫貴妃令大皇子感染瘟疫而死。林少春為孫貴妃打抱不平，提出疑點，皇上批准召李太醫家人進宮，同時下旨包圍孫府。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、梁嘉琪邀請張智軒，來到大嶼山的石壁宿舍做義工。幾位義工各司其職，嘉琪與智軒主力洗廁所，家樂、阿滕與欣欣則隨宿友參觀壁畫角。他們欣賞作品後突然畫興大發，自動請纓替宿舍多添兩幅壁畫，過程中最高興的莫過於與小孩子真誠交流。隨後，阿滕與欣欣大展廚藝，獎勵一眾勞苦功高的小畫家。午飯後，家樂與智軒各自領軍與宿友來一場「友誼波」，家樂以大欺小不成，反被對方魚肉？

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 吳家樂、江欣燕、范振鋒到林村做義工，為保育圍村文化出一分力。幾位主持在鄉公所首副主席邦哥帶領下幫忙修建道路，令防空洞得以重見天日。眾人「雞手鴨腳」完成任務，欣欣還在水泥地上留下筆跡。眾人享用林村傳統茶果糕點後到百年古屋尋寶，幫忙將寶物運到文物儲存室，順道欣賞其他文物，如八卦碗、雞宅等，當中一封家書勾起了欣欣對父親的回憶。邦哥細說文物背後的故事，為眾人介紹富歷史價值和快失傳的林村鄉圍村文化。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙特阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 在雲南大理，黎諾懿繼續協助法籍私房菜大廚預備招待各國來的朋友，終教他明白法國菜要吃多個小時的理由！諾懿煲出水鴨湯讓大家品評，結論竟是各人演技太好？諾懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小島，到一間由曾是互聯網公司強人營辦的民宿，幫忙招待客人，客人卻嫌棄他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令諾懿感到納悶，幸好老闆帶他到市集閒逛，諾懿竟找到適合楊明食用的手信？試過了歸隱田園，諾懿還堅持嚮往田園生活嗎？

programme.title: 兄弟姊妹去旅行粵
programme.desc: 蕭正楠、曹永廉、胡定欣、姚子羚「被組團」去瑞士旅行。兩女豪坐頭等艙，為何阿廉「一支公」坐商務客位？先到中古世紀小城琉森，走上打卡熱點教堂橋Selfie，再到旁邊市集買燒烤食物，兩男不理素食的子羚不停買肉，還取笑她們買了可辟邪的蔬果。乘坐全球首部360度旋轉纜車登上鐵力士山峰，鬥快滑雪兜，阿廉還差點出意外！在特里步湖划艇及燒烤，悠閒地分享旅行經歷，阿蕭有趟旅行後出現長達半年「後遺症」，聽聽他的忠告！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主汛文提出與拍檔們圍繞「倫理道德」主題聊天，並以快問快答揭開序幕。她概述倫理學的三大分支概念，並進一步介紹其中的後設倫理學，還以插隊、偽君子等做例子；凱婷感同身受分享友人「講一套做一套」的經歷。回到開場問題，原來可反映眾人的抉擇是根據結果論、義務論或德性倫理學的思考模式。汛文也引述多位哲學家的學說，並帶出「兇手敲門」的思想實驗。她又引領拍檔將視野延伸至東方智慧，從中比較儒家、墨家與道家的學說。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院粵
programme.desc: 李龍基對被模仿感榮幸，這集親身亮相學院現場，與扮演他的福祿壽三子同台演唱。分組對決首回合「復刻經典舞台」上演，由專業評審羅冠蘭與觀眾一同打分。阮兆祥派趙頌宜演繹莫文蔚的<呼吸有害，頌宜表現獲大讚，得分竟因某人而拉低？王祖藍安排鄭詠謙扮曾比特、湯卓堅扮林子祥重演《聲生不息》舞台合唱，最終由於「第三者」出現令人略嫌失望？關嘉敏、葉泓聲獲李思捷指派重現張國榮的「鴛鴦舞王」演出，表演後卻感自責？

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集的菜式是西洋菜豆腐羹，主持人教大家怎樣吃到幼嫩的西洋菜，而又不用浪費的方法，材料清洗乾淨後，先將部分耐煮的材料放進鍋子裡熬煮，待味道出來後再加入西洋菜及豆腐，煮沸後勾芡，就成為清爽又有飽腹感的菜式

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 心愛檸檬與拍檔凱龍找上祭與喵姆，向她們求教星光魔法。檸檬極度怕羞，難以跟陌生人溝通，枉論登台表演。祭找來希娜幫忙，希娜提出讓她代替檸檬登台。看過希娜的表演後，檸檬上網留言表達感受。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練黃Sir又再前來「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，指導大家展開一連串富趣味的體能鍛練。首先是利用豆袋與毛巾訓練反應與速度，某些動作要兩人一組去做，更會加入互相競逐的遊戲元素，令運動更添樂趣。隨後的平衡力訓練則用上雪糕筒作輔助，除了充當定位工具之外，還會兩人一組手持雪糕筒互相觸碰，詳情如何？這次「動物好萌友」，同來觀察可愛唐狗Lotus的生活點滴。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 2026年王者榮耀KPL年度總決賽·決賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 「王者榮耀」KPL十周年，兩支北京電競隊在年度總決賽狹路相逢，爭逐榮耀加冕！北京JDG戰隊一路由勝者組強勢推進，明星選手無畏、清融是致勝關鍵。北京WB戰隊從敗者組逆襲而歸，打野暖陽、射手昭珏都是陣中核心。此外，表演嘉賓周深會以歌聲加持「榮耀」殿堂。TVB翡翠台、明珠台接力播映這場BO7大戰，主持張與辰、彭家賢、施焯日、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編黃瀅仴，聯同兩位電競評述員老星、伍嘉豪，跟觀眾迎接「王者」駕臨！

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 香港連續16年成為樓價最難負擔城巿，為了讓買家更易「上車」，10多年前本港出現面積細、總價低的納米樓，最細實用面積只有128呎。但近年陸續有納米樓蝕讓，部分跌價超過五成，自住業主「先上車、後換樓」的計劃暫時未能實現，他們長年蝸居的生活是怎樣？政府五年規劃提出逐步增加室內樓面面積，讓巿民住大點。在解決迫切房屋需求的同時，政府如何在增加居住空間上作出平衡？樓面面積增加，港人買樓難的「老問題」又可否解決呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打優先理財呈獻：Grand住去首爾粵
programme.desc: 參觀百年歷史韓屋，海寧細味傳統韓茶文化，尋回久違的自在慢活。隨後，她會跟韓國小鮮肉甜蜜約會學製陶瓷花樽，更齊齊登船夜遊睇靚景兼談天。嘉洛與朱仔相約大吃烤鰻魚補身，體驗韓國男人的進補之道。二人接着兵分兩路，嘉洛造訪頂流韓星御用美容院大改造，變身韓系型男走在街頭，成功吸引「韓國妹豬」集郵；朱仔則換上量身訂製西裝，靜心品嚐美酒獨享優雅時刻。壓軸三人會合享用新派韓國料理，前菜的滋味已令大家失去言語能力！

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻：香港連場好戲粵PG
programme.desc: 從劇情片中的逆境奮鬥故事，領會香港精神！現已拆卸的九龍城寨，曾有「三不管」的傳奇色彩，兩主持約同演員伍允龍走進電影展覽館，穿梭光影場景與舊日時空交織的「圍城」。砵甸乍街、中環街市等歷史角落，散發着獨特的電影韻味；深入石澳，也可細味《喜劇之王》的追夢與愛情故事。《逆流大叔》於城門河奮力划槳，電影導演陳詠燊訴說創作靈感。《毒舌大狀》為討公義，在前粉嶺裁判法院唇槍舌劍，演員謝君豪憶述實景拍攝法庭戲感受。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港車手方俊宇將夥拍德國名將晏高，征戰澳門大賽車GT世界盃，俊宇從拍檔身上學到甚麼？西班牙球星大衛施華首戰港超聯，助至尊沙田以1比1賽和標準流浪，他還會暢談來港踢波感受。黎志豪當選新一任欖總主席，他提到希望將本港欖球推動到社區，及發展至大灣區。五位健美港將會出戰亞錦賽，備戰情況如何？香港馬術盛典將於1月舉行，法國騎手率先來港交流。另搜羅三鐵世界盃戰報，以及壁球公開賽、粵港澳大灣區匹克球賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 飛虎3壯志英雄#21粵PG
programme.desc: Mike涉嫌一宗謀殺案而被通緝，Mike向Don堅稱被陷害；博文問敏莉有否見過Mike，她稱沒有；素筠向敏莉表示自己患有漸凍症，希望她不要告訴博文；嘉軒和家寶調查許森的背景，發現收養他的濟群會有問題，於是再深入調查。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵
programme.desc: 在雲南大理，黎諾懿繼續協助法籍私房菜大廚預備招待各國來的朋友，終教他明白法國菜要吃多個小時的理由！諾懿煲出水鴨湯讓大家品評，結論竟是各人演技太好？諾懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小島，到一間由曾是互聯網公司強人營辦的民宿，幫忙招待客人，客人卻嫌棄他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令諾懿感到納悶，幸好老闆帶他到市集閒逛，諾懿竟找到適合楊明食用的手信？試過了歸隱田園，諾懿還堅持嚮往田園生活嗎？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 粵語「㜺鬼」傳神，博大精深，香港不少俗話亦源自廣東省各地。㜺鬼大使麥美恩遂將探索版圖擴展至中國，並找來鄧智堅、戴祖儀、許文軒加入「㜺鬼導賞團」，深入廣州等內地城市，發掘相關的有趣典故及出處。專業粵語及典故專家亦會現身，追源溯古引經據典，揭示貼地粵語的魅力所在。此外，喜歡扮鬼扮馬的鄧智堅還於節目化身單身宅男，透過他追求一眾「女神」的過程，讓大家了解多個俗語及術語的含意。

programme.title: 2026英雄聯盟全球總決賽冠亞軍決賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 2026「英雄聯盟」全球大賽在美國舉行，韓國LCK戰區第一種子GenG、中國LPL戰區第二種子BLG，從瑞士輪、淘汰賽階段殺出重圍，會師總決賽戰場。GenG中路明星選手Chovy與BLG中路左手戰將Knight，迎來「左右手」巔峰對決，力爭帶領戰隊登上榮譽之巔。主持戴祖儀、林沚羿、彭家賢、電競評述員老星、彭泳熙、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編吳文懿，坐鎮TVB翡翠台，由開幕表演到BO5「中韓大戰」全程直擊！

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge

The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Ice Cream
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a lick of each other's ice cream. But they are so focused on making sure each lick is fair, they don't notice their ice creams are melting.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Albatross, Bird that Rides the Wind
programme.desc: Everyone learns about the gliding bird that is the Albatross. It soars without flapping it's wings! But how?!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man

The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.
